referenceRole: Approved structural template; replace environmental identity while preserving overall composition.

concepts.name: Crescent Observatory
concepts.brief: A welcoming observatory built into the inner curve of a small crescent moon. Upper LEFT a large ivory-and-antique-brass refracting telescope on a sturdy worn blue-moonstone pedestal, visibly mounted with a pivot and iris. Upper RIGHT a beautiful cutaway domed observatory with softly glowing tiny amber windows; a sweeping crescent-shaped stone buttress connects it to the arena's right wall. A little cobalt cosmic sky is visible between them, no huge bright moon backdrop. Keep lunar craters broad and sparse, with small pearly mineral clusters at the outer edges. Side rails are layered midnight-blue lunar stone with muted pewter tops. Playing field is matte inky navy. Foreground reading shelf is integrated moonstone with midnight leather inset and brass corner fasteners, NOT brown wood. Lower-right secondary object a small hinged moonphase lantern with a warm amber slit and silver crescent dial, physically on the outer shelf. Mood: the stars' familiar home observatory, cozy and curious. Palette: navy #141C32, dusty slate blue #475B78, soft pewter #8B97A5, selective antique brass and tiny amber windows. Avoid plants, earthlike gardens, and bright white architecture across the field.

A secondary tactile prop may sit at the OUTER lower right without covering the reading recess or action wells. Keep a spacious readable center and the five functional recesses entirely empty. concepts.name: Nebula Nursery
concepts.brief: A celestial nursery where wisps of nebula light are gently gathered into a quiet starlight cradle, physically built on a pearl-gray fragment of an ancient moon. Upper LEFT a large elegant curved nacre rib arcs around a glass nebula collector on a short visible cradle: contained smoky rose-and-lilac cloud, one small warm core. Upper RIGHT a squat rounded smoky-glass incubation dome with a mechanical petal iris, resting on layered porcelain and dark rose-metal support. Above them a restrained violet nebula wisp in space; scenery is close, no panorama. Quiet side rims are organically layered nacre and dusty mauve ceramic, broad smooth shapes like cupped hands, no leaves or terrestrial greenhouse. Central collecting surface is nearly black smoky aubergine #211C2D with no stars or bright mist. Foreground continuous curved ceramic reading shelf, dark plum textile inset and two dark rounded action wells. Lower-right small dew-like starlight vessel on a firm nacre base with one hinged petal cap. Mood tender, magical, safe, a place young stars would belong. Palette smoky plum, desaturated mauve #6E556D, pearl-gray #A7A0B1 and tiny rose-gold joints; only small lavender/pink cloud accents high in corners. Keep architecture darker than bright crystal characters. No plants, flowers, actual infant characters, jars full of star-shaped characters or faces.

concepts.name: Orbital Orrery
concepts.brief: A solid astronomical lookout anchored to a chunk of the rocky ring of an immense distant ringed planet. Upper LEFT a huge close tactile ringed-planet orrery: one muted ocher globe supported inside two broad tilted antique-gold orbital hoops on a short bolted plinth. Make this the unmistakable silhouette, not a telescope. Upper RIGHT a smaller tracking lens on a curved stone arm with a handwheel and a tiny sheltered amber lamp. A distant pale ring arcs through a narrow cosmic gap between props, with very dark space behind. Foundation consists of rounded charcoal meteorite and sandstone-colored metal; connect every mount, rim and foreground ledge into one real object. Side rims dark slate meteorite with satin champagne metal seams, not rubble everywhere. Center matte midnight charcoal #171D29. Foreground one continuous brushed dark bronze charting ledge with dark slate reading inset and two inset action wells. Lower-right a compact orbital dial in a gimbal with visible pivot and little counterweight. Palette charcoal, desaturated warm umber #665646, muted champagne #A68B5A; small slate-blue shadows. Sunny's yellow crystal must stay more luminous and saturated than the globe. Mood poised, clockwork, spacious cosmic navigation. No steam workshop, furnaces, industrial grunge, exposed earth grass or wooden tavern.

concepts.name: Aurora Spire
concepts.brief: A polar observatory perched on a crystalline moon, designed to listen to and split the aurora's light. Upper LEFT a large fan-shaped array of three curved smoky-glass optical fins on silver articulated mounts, with a narrow controlled cyan-green reflection. Upper RIGHT a compact faceted frosted-glass observatory spire on a dark stone base, visible tiny warm-white slit doorway; a short curved light conduit connects fins and spire across the rear foundation. A dim folded green-violet aurora occupies only the small topmost background gap. Rounded blue-black polar rock underlies translucent frosted edges. Narrow side rails of dark petrol mineral with opalescent glass caps; they should read tactile and calm rather than a bright neon frame. Central field nearly black petrol #15262D, matte and completely clear, no mist or frost motifs inside the playable rectangle. Foreground reading shelf a continuous thick smoky-glass and silver bridge with dark leather/stone inset and two dark action wells. Lower-right a tiny prism shutter instrument on a visible pivot, closed except for one soft sliver of light. Palette deep petrol, blue-gray #4B6873, muted silver #9CA7AC, small cool mint and violet edge lights. Mood hushed, crystalline, airy, close and intimate. Avoid large white icy areas, pointy hazardous shards, green grass, water fountains and ocean shells.

concepts.name: Spiral Archive
concepts.brief: A galaxy cartographer's observatory with a giant cosmic atlas physically housed in a deeply curved cabinet of midnight mineral and dusky rose-bronze. Upper LEFT the dominant prop is a round tilted concave glass galaxy chart mounted in an elegant stout fork: inside it a contained, softly luminous spiral galaxy with two broad dusty lavender arms and a small pearl core, like a tactile astronomical lens that holds a miniature view of the Milky Way. Upper RIGHT a compact open star-atlas folio with embossed orbital pages on an angled bracket and a small shaded lamp. Everything is attached to a single curved dark obsidian-and-bronze archival cabinet, with obvious hinges and modest rounded profiles, no clutter of shelves. A narrow glimpse of deep cobalt galactic space at the very top. Side rails are sculpted midnight slate with sparse bronze constellation studs on OUTER rims only. Broad central surface near-black ink plum #1C1B2A, matte and entirely empty, no drawn charts or galaxy over the field. Foreground connected midnight-blue cabinet drawer becomes the dark reading shelf and two action recesses. Lower-right a hinged brass celestial compass with a smoked-lavender lens, neatly supported at the far edge. Palette ink plum, slate violet #4B465F, desaturated rose bronze #88746D, tiny pearl galaxy light. Mood wonder, memory, intimate cosmic home. No rainbow explosion, library wall panorama, giant glowing galaxy behind gameplay, stacks covering control wells or bright pink nebula everywhere.
